reason: The single planned bilingual alignment retest still produced only 0-3 exact record selections per 12 questions for every checkpoint. Persistent signature, field/qualifier and handle errors precede correct retrieval.
research_role_zh: 领域接入的共同适配步骤；不作为新增算法创新，不替代公开数据上的恢复轨迹SFT主方法。
next_deliverable_zh: 先构建可执行且可审阅的接口监督小包，再冻结一次匹配预算适配方案；当前未生成该训练包，也未启动训练。

draft_data_scope.knowledge: Explicitly fictitious entities and values for tool semantics; no fabricated claims about actual radar equipment.
coverage: valid handles and stopping after selecting the intended result
draft_data_scope.target: Canonical successful execution trajectories under the unchanged development tool contract; no erroneous trajectory recovery or preference objective in this common alignment phase.
draft_data_scope.target_budget: Choose and freeze after tokenization and semantic review, before any adaptation run.

isolation.synthetic_group_unit: Shared entity aliases, knowledge instance and paraphrase/template family stay in one group; bilingual variants never split across groups.

cpu_admission: Check query meaning against the synthetic instance, not merely executor self-consistency.
Replay every reference and verify exact selected records, range endpoints, conditions, event and unknown scope.
Verify references terminate with existing answer handles; erroneous calls create no handles.
Check no original development record identifiers, literal answers or source-context text appear in synthetic training rows.
Separate question-only generation files from references; record source/generator/version hashes and exact supervised token counts.

comparison_design.A_C: Both existing continuation seeds, each adapted with the identical corpus/order, supervised token budget and optimization configuration. Do not choose one favorable seed.
comparison_design.P: Retain the existing program baseline. Any adapted P arm must use the same task instances and disclose different output serialization/supervision length; do not claim automatically token-matched training against agents.

decision_boundary_zh: 数据包与CPU核验完成后，先固定训练/诊断分组、样本和监督预算、超参数、对照、指标及停止规则，才决定实施小规模适配。若适配只记住示例或合成保留组仍不能正确调用，就停止扩大训练。真实雷达效果必须另用来源隔离的新资料检查。
